description: NFC under Unicode 16.0.0: TODHRI U+105D2 + U+0307 composes to U+105C9 (a composite new in 16.0; Unicode 15.x leaves the pair unchanged)
notes: Version guard (spec §3.4.1.1, plan unicode_text_rule §1.4): under the pinned Unicode 16.0.0 the pair MUST encode as U+105C9 (UTF-8 F0 90 97 89, len prefix 4); a 15.x table leaves it as U+105D2 U+0307 (6 bytes). Expected bytes written by hand from the spec layout, hash by the xxhash package.
